def test_rollout_fraction_parses_to_percent():
    assert load_flag({"name": "warehouse_pick", "rollout": "0.25"}).rollout_pct == 25
    assert load_flag({"name": "x", "rollout": "0.29"}).rollout_pct == 29


def test_warehouse_pick_quarter_rollout_includes_bucket_15():
    flag = load_flag({"name": "warehouse_pick", "rollout": "0.25"})
    assert bucket_for("u0200") == 15
    assert is_enabled(flag, "u0200") is True


def test_deny_list_applies_to_new_checkout():
    flag = load_flag({"name": "new_checkout", "rollout": "0.10", "deny": ["u0128"]})
    assert is_enabled(flag, "u0128") is False
